fields.name: placement
fields.description: Position preset (default: `'top-right'`). Explicit insets override it.

fields.name: top
fields.description: Top inset in pixels or as a CSS length.

fields.name: right
fields.description: Right inset in pixels or as a CSS length.

fields.name: bottom
fields.description: Bottom inset in pixels or as a CSS length.

fields.name: left
fields.description: Left inset in pixels or as a CSS length.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Surface width in pixels or as a CSS length.

fields.name: maxWidth
fields.description: Maximum surface width in pixels or as a CSS length.

fields.name: maxHeight
fields.description: Maximum surface height in pixels or as a CSS length.

fields.name: autoFocus
fields.description: Focus the find input when the surface opens (default: true).

fields.name: closeOnOutsidePointerDown
fields.description: Close the surface when a pointer press occurs outside it (default: false).
